recentItems.title: Women and Power | How Sergeant Beatrice Jemutai built a career capturing crocodiles, hippos & lions
recentItems.description:
After 19 years with Kenya Wildlife Service, Sergeant Beatrice Jemutai Mitei has built a career of capturing crocodiles, hippos and lions while challenging perceptions about women in wildlife operation.

Sergeant, Beatrice who is veterinary and intervention officer, has been leading a team of 29 officers in capturing and relocating more than 50 crocodiles from Lake Baringo, as rising waters intensify human-wildlife conflict. Crocodiles in Lake Baringo.

Crocodiles have ventured closer to the communities, attacking people and livestock.
